label: Fault/source geometry
fields_or_block_structure: Source code, magnitude or frequency block, point/fault-plane coordinates, depth, length, width, strike, dip
official_role: Rectangular, non-rectangular, and discretized source geometries for specified and area sources.
reconstruction_status: Public input in CSV and shapefile forms. Geometry still needs source-model conversion for a full rerun.
paper_use: Shows that official source geometry is downloadable and versioned.

label: Occurrence-frequency grids for sources without specified faults
fields_or_block_structure: MNO, JLG, JLA, WLG, WLA, FRQ, BVL, MMN, ANO, DEP, STR, DIP
official_role: Mesh-based occurrence frequencies, b-values, minimum magnitudes, zone identifiers, depths, strikes, and dips for background or area sources.
reconstruction_status: Public input. Needs gridded-source translation and validation against J-SHIS calculation settings.
paper_use: Documents the public background-source input layer.

label: Zoning-area polygons
official_role: Area boundaries used by source-frequency models.
reconstruction_status: Public input. Needed to reconstruct area-source occurrence models.
paper_use: Documents spatial zoning used by background-source files.

label: Seismic activity parameters for specified faults
fields_or_block_structure: CODE, PROC, AVRACT, NEWACT, ALPHA, P_T30, P_T50, NAME
official_role: Recurrence process, mean recurrence interval, latest-event time, variance, and 30/50-year occurrence probabilities for specified active-fault and subduction sources.
reconstruction_status: Public input. Needs conversion from J-SHIS CSV conventions to an executable PSHA source model.
paper_use: Supports a documented official-source input-chain audit.

label: EQTHR activity and geometry
fields_or_block_structure: Fault code, recurrence interval, magnitude bounds, b-value, and fault geometry
official_role: Parameters and geometry for earthquakes whose traces are hard to recognize from surface evidence.
reconstruction_status: Public input. Needs conversion and validation.

label: Interplate/intraplate occurrence ratio
official_role: Ratios used to split plate-interface and intraslab occurrence components.
reconstruction_status: Public input. Must be mapped into the executable source logic.

label: Pacific/Philippine Sea plate depth surfaces
fields_or_block_structure: MNO, JLG, JLA, WLG, WLA, DEP
official_role: Gridded plate-surface depth points for plate-interface and intraslab source treatment.
reconstruction_status: Public input. Needs validated interpolation and source-placement logic.

label: Attenuation-relation parameter codes
official_role: J-SHIS code mapping for earthquake type, source-position type, magnitude-conversion type, and crustal-type flag.
reconstruction_status: Public input. The numerical GMPE implementation and calculation switches must be verified before claiming a full official rerun.
paper_use: Defines the remaining bridge between official source inputs and ground-motion calculation.
